title: The Max Headroom TV Signal Hijacking
description: In 1987, an unknown intruder interrupted television broadcasts in Chicago with a bizarre masked performance. Despite an investigation, the person responsible was never publicly identified.

scenes.narration: On November 22, 1987, Chicago television viewers saw something they were never supposed to see.
